_compare_origins_note: Always shown side by side in every alert, even when another airport is cheaper
_origin_allowance_note: Extra $ you'd pay to fly from this airport: it alerts on its own at target + this amount, and alerts mark whether its price gap is within it
_destinations_note: IATA city codes -> round-trip USD alert threshold
_events_note: Fixed-date trips checked directly on Google Flights (live_check origins), with their own target. Checks start once Google sells the dates (~horizon_days ahead) and repeat every check_every_days. Each check = 1 SerpApi search per origin.
_weather_note: Typical weather for each alert's trip dates, averaged over the same dates in past years. units: fahrenheit or celsius
_charts_note: Attach a price chart image to each alert (rendered by quickchart.io; only price numbers are sent)

charts._min_own_history_note: When Google has no price history, chart our own saved daily prices once this many days exist

_live_check_note: Live Google Flights price (SerpApi, key in SERPAPI_KEY env var) for deals about to alert. Free plan = 250 searches/month; each deal costs 1 search per origin

live_check._confirm_note: Skip an alert if the live price no longer beats the target. confirm_leeway 0.05 = still alert when live is up to 5% over target
live_check._recheck_note: If the same destination + dates was live-checked within this many days and was over target, skip it without spending searches

notify._priority_note: Priority 5 (urgent) when the price is at least 25% under target, 4 (high) at 10%+, else 3 (normal)

_travelpayouts_token_note: Leave empty; set TRAVELPAYOUTS_TOKEN in /etc/fare_watch.env instead
